chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"In the clay of the grave of al-Husayn, peace be upon him, there is healing from every ailment, and it is the greatest remedy."

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام, whose grave is mentioned
key_terms.طِينِ: clay; the sacred earth being described
key_terms.قَبْرِ: grave; the burial place referred to in the hadith

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the healing power of the clay of Imam al-Husayn’s grave?
ai.summary: This hadith states that in the clay of the grave of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام there is healing from every illness. It presents this soil as a divinely endowed means of cure and highlights the special sanctity of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام and his grave.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3204 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"In the clay of the grave of al-Husayn (as) is healing for every ailment, and it is the greatest remedy."
